CheckoutModal.jsx L52-54 useEffect keyed on [open] correctly resets both form state AND event_id when the modal opens. Verified empirically that reopening yields a new UUID.
MessageForm.jsx L71 (form_submitted) and L123 (book_demo) both pass the same eventId — funnel stitching for /contact confirmed with a single event_id.
